title: 감사원 정책자문위원회 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Composition)
(1) The Committee shall consist of not more than 20 non-standing members, including one Chairperson and one Vice-Chairperson. <Amended on Jun. 30, 2016; Aug. 29, 2022>
(2) The Chairperson shall be elected by and from among the members, and the Vice-Chairperson shall be designated by the Chairperson. <Amended on Jun. 30, 2016>
(3) Members shall be commissioned by the Chairperson of the Board of Audit and Inspection from among persons with extensive experience and professional expertise in various fields of society, including law, public administration, taxation, and accounting. <Amended on Aug. 29, 2022>
